sentences.text: Earlier, the first bail application was dismissed as withdrawn on 16.12.2021 in MCRC No. 8632 of 2021 with liberty to repeat the bail application after recording of statement of the prosecutrix.
3. Case of the prosecution, in brief is that the applicant is working as Sub-engineer in Water Resource Department.
He allured the prosecutrix Neutral Citation 2023:CGHC:28495 on the pretext of marriage and made physical relationship with her.
It is also the case of the prosecution that the applicant has developed illicit relationship with the prosecutrix for more than one year on the count that he has lost his wife and he will marry her.
When she became pregnant, she was admitted in hospital by the applicant and abortion was done.
Thereafter, the applicant refused to marry her which necessitated her to file the complaint before the concerned police station.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the applicant is suffering from paralysis, his medical condition is very deteriorated.
He needs assistance in his routine work.
He would further submit that the prosecutrix has been examined before the trial Court wherein she has stated that if the applicant has not suffered paralysis, she would not have lodged the FIR.

He would further submit that the prosecutrix is major lady aged about 35 years, she must be aware of the consequence of the physical relationship, therefore, prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.

5. Learned counsel for the applicant would further submit that two important witnesses namely Francis Kachhap and Anuranjna Kachhap have been examined before the trial Court and further 15 more witnesses are to be examined, therefore conclusion of the trial may take more time, the applicant is in jail since 08.10.2021, more than 2 years have already lapsed, therefore, the applicant may kindly be released on bail.
6.

On the other hand, learned counsel for the State opposes the bail application and would submit that the applicant is involved in heinous crime against woman, therefore, he may not be released on bail.
Neutral Citation 2023:CGHC:28495 7.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.

8. This Court to verify the factual matrix whether the applicant has suffered paralytic attack or not,
directed the State to verify the fact and file documents to demonstrate the same.

Pursuant to the direction, the State has filed information along with medical certificate received from the Jail Superintendent, Central Jail, Ambikapur wherein it has been stated that the applicant was diagnosed old CVA with Hypertension and he has right sided Hemiparesis.

9. Considering the submission made by the learned counsel for the parties, the case diary, the materials collected during the investigation, statement of the prosecutrix that if the applicant had not suffered paralysis, she would not have made complaint and also considering the fact that she is Panchram Banjare vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 10 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/182836110/

sentences.text:
major lady, considering the medical condition of the applicant, considering the applicant has already remained in jail for more than two years, considering the fact that the important witnesses have been already examined and further 15 witnesses are to be examined which may take more time,
I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.

10. Accordingly, the bail application is allowed and It is directed that in the event of the applicant executing a personal bond for a sum of Rs. 25,000/- with a surety of Rs. 25,000/- to the satisfaction of the concerned trial Court, then he shall be released on bail.
He is directed to appear before the trial Court on each and every date given to him till disposal of the trial.
11. Certified copy today itself.
